scientific_limitations: General complete intersections over the complex numbers only.
The parametrized linear spaces have positive dimension k >= 1.
The expected dimension is exactly two and the ambient dimension is restricted to the standard range r >= 2k + m.
Special complete intersections with singular, reducible, or excess-dimensional Fano schemes are outside scope.
An unindexed classical source could contain the same short canonical-positivity corollary.
title: Canonical positivity dichotomy for Fano surfaces of complete intersections
